scope: 56 individually authored encounters in eight batches. Earliest sector11. One seeded roll per sector:12% through20,16% through40,18% later. At most one active or per level; exclude bosses and conflicting special encounters. Original ImageGen part atlases and original ElevenLabs banks; no local synthesized audio.

entries.name: Glass Widow
entries.appearance: Translucent crystal arachnid
entries.behavior: Marks three recent player positions, locks them, then strikes those positions in order.
entries.counterplay: Keep moving until the locks settle; cross into a cleared strike position.
entries.sound: Brittle crystalline clicks, stressed glass calls, sharp articulated claw snaps.

entries.name: Cinder Manta
entries.appearance: Charcoal manta with ember-veined wings
entries.behavior: Sweeping wings lay burning wakes; destroying a wing opens a cool corridor.
entries.counterplay: Break one wing root and use its missing wake to cross safely.
entries.sound: Deep furnace breath, heavy leathery sail snaps, granular ember surges.

entries.name: Needle Saint
entries.appearance: Tall ivory armored sniper organism
entries.behavior: Tracks through several sighting beats before locking a narrow piercing lance.
entries.counterplay: Bait the final sighting, then move off the locked firing line.
entries.sound: Rising bone whistle, cold precision clicks, a powerful clean lance crack.

entries.name: Blind Leviathan
entries.appearance: Eyeless basalt-armored abyssal animal
entries.behavior: A sensing band registers movement and chooses a clearly warned charge lane.
entries.counterplay: Hold position during a safe scan, or bait its lock and move aside.
entries.sound: Cavernous growls, deep living sonar, dense armored rushing impacts.

entries.name: Lantern Eater
entries.appearance: Vast jaw creature with luminous feeding organs
entries.behavior: Consumes its own drifting lanterns to strengthen the next attack.
entries.counterplay: Shoot the lanterns before they reach its mouth.
entries.sound: Wet cavern gulps, delicate electric chirps, muscular jaw claps.

entries.name: Scissor Twins
entries.appearance: Paired scarred metal predators
entries.behavior: Two linked predators close from opposite sides with a cutting tether.
entries.counterplay: Destroy one twin to break the pincer and disable the tether.
entries.sound: Two contrasting engine voices, tension creaks, shearing metal snaps.

entries.name: Red Wake
entries.appearance: Hot needle-shaped comet predator
entries.behavior: Fast warned passes leave wakes that fire sideways after a delay.
entries.counterplay: Move behind the pass and keep clear of the marked wake edges.
entries.sound: Doppler engine howl, aerodynamic tearing, staccato plasma crackle.

entries.name: Foldship
entries.appearance: Intricately articulated folding spacecraft
entries.behavior: Alternates compact armor with unfolded weapons and vulnerable hinges.
entries.counterplay: Attack the exposed hinge during deployment; move before the weapon fan locks.
entries.sound: Heavy articulated locks, layered servo whirs, compact pressure discharges.

entries.name: Doorwraith
entries.appearance: Fractured portal body around a living core
entries.behavior: Routes its own shots through paired portals with an announced exit.
entries.counterplay: Read the exit portal before each volley rather than chasing the entry.
entries.sound: Vacuum pressure pops, reversed space echoes, dry portal collapses.

entries.name: Tidemason
entries.appearance: Enormous layered mineral current-shaper
entries.behavior: Forms visible currents that bend hostile shots along readable curves.
entries.counterplay: Use the quiet side of the current and fire into exposed mineral seams.
entries.sound: Tectonic groans, heavy rushing fluid fields, stone resonance.

entries.name: Parallax Hunter
entries.appearance: Reflective hunter with coherent luminous echoes
entries.behavior: Separates into matching copies while the real body keeps an unbroken engine wake.
entries.counterplay: Follow the continuous physical wake and damage the real hull.
entries.sound: Offset engine pulses, restrained spatial echoes, hard metallic impacts.

entries.name: Clockray
entries.appearance: Transparent ray enclosing suspended clockwork
entries.behavior: Suspends its own shots, then releases groups to a visible rhythm.
entries.counterplay: Read the pulsing release order and cross between groups.
entries.sound: Precise mechanical ticking, glass resonance, measured bass pulses.

entries.name: Horizon Biter
entries.appearance: Crescent jaw with massive lateral locking armor
entries.behavior: Closes the outer lanes with jaws and exposes the locking latches.
entries.counterplay: Destroy a latch to reopen a side lane.
entries.sound: Straining structural metal, colossal jaw movement, sub-bass bites.

entries.name: Rift Surgeon
entries.appearance: Three-pronged surgical rift machine
entries.behavior: Cuts diagonal tears that become dangerous in sequence and close behind the cut.
entries.counterplay: Cross immediately behind a closing tear instead of ahead of the blade.
entries.sound: Focused surgical whine, dimensional fabric tearing, sealing snaps.

entries.name: Bloom Queen
entries.appearance: Armored flower surrounding a fleshy reactor
entries.behavior: Grows branching weapon buds whose descendants depend on their parent branch.
entries.counterplay: Sever a parent branch to remove all its attached buds.
entries.sound: Wet unfolding petals, woody cracks, visceral reactor breathing.

entries.name: Brood Ark
entries.appearance: Translucent egg carrier with layered membrane sails
entries.behavior: Releases eggs with clearly visible hatch timers while continuing its own attacks.
entries.counterplay: Choose between damaging the carrier and destroying eggs before they hatch.
entries.sound: Membrane knocks, muffled hatchling chatter, deep nurturing rumbles.

entries.name: Carrion Weaver
entries.appearance: Many-legged salvage organism
entries.behavior: Stitches nearby wrecks into fresh armor using exposed construction tendrils.
entries.counterplay: Cut the active tendril before the new armor closes.
entries.sound: Dragging debris, stretched tendons, clicking graft tools.

entries.name: Spore Monk
entries.appearance: Fungal creature draped in layered spore mantles
entries.behavior: Plants destructible spore clusters that occupy lanes and slowly expand.
entries.counterplay: Shoot a passage through the clusters and keep it open.
entries.sound: Breathy fungal air, soft pressure detonations, hushed organic rasp.

entries.name: Husk Parade
entries.appearance: Procession of hollow armored shells
entries.behavior: A luminous core visibly transfers between otherwise empty hosts.
entries.counterplay: Follow the exposed transfer and attack the occupied shell.
entries.sound: Hollow ceramic knocks, a moving heartbeat, brittle empty-shell collapses.

entries.name: Magnet Urchin
entries.appearance: Dense metallic-spined living urchin
entries.behavior: Detaches armored spines as mines, exposing the central body until recall.
entries.counterplay: Attack the body during deployment and escape the announced recall paths.
entries.sound: Magnetic rattles, tense metallic harmonics, powerful electrical snaps.

entries.name: Chrysalis Hunter
entries.appearance: Heavy cocoon opening into an angular winged predator
entries.behavior: An announced armor break transforms its movement and attack pattern.
entries.counterplay: Use the cocoon phase to prepare space; react to the new winged silhouette.
entries.sound: Layered shell fractures, muscular emergence, explosive wing thunder.

entries.name: Rail Cathedral
entries.appearance: Articulated war train with cathedral-like machinery
entries.behavior: Each carriage carries a different weapon and is connected by an exposed coupling.
entries.counterplay: Destroy couplings to detach carriages and remove their attacks.
entries.sound: Massive rail impacts, distant machinery, straining carriage couplings.

entries.name: Siege Orchid
entries.appearance: Mechanical armored flower with recessed cannon petals
entries.behavior: Petals fire sequentially, leaving a moving vulnerable cooling sector.
entries.counterplay: Follow the cool sector and attack its open machinery.
entries.sound: Servo harmonics, petal locks, distinct heavy cannon reports.

entries.name: Bulwark Hauler
entries.appearance: Structural tug hauling massive shield cargo
entries.behavior: Moves genuine cover through the playfield while exposing towing machinery.
entries.counterplay: Use its cargo to block hostile fire and shoot the unshielded tug.
entries.sound: Deep towing rumble, chains under load, shielded cargo impacts.

entries.name: Bellfoundry
entries.appearance: Bronze aerospace forge with a suspended casting chamber
entries.behavior: Casts hot objects that visibly cool into useful cover.
entries.counterplay: Avoid glowing castings, then use the cooled material to block attacks.
entries.sound: Foundry roar, molten metal movement, deep bronze bell strikes.

entries.name: Prism Bastion
entries.appearance: Asymmetric crystal fortress with separate optical towers
entries.behavior: Outer crystals split the main beam into additional directions.
entries.counterplay: Destroy the splitter crystals to simplify the firing pattern.
entries.sound: Dense resonant crystal tones, optical pressure whines, ringing fractures.

entries.name: Cable Kraken
entries.appearance: Heavy spool machine with articulated cable limbs
entries.behavior: Energizes cables between destructible anchor modules.
entries.counterplay: Break an anchor to remove its cable and open a route.
entries.sound: Cable tension, industrial spool motors, electrical arc lashes.

entries.name: Switchyard
entries.appearance: Orange command engine with switching tracks
entries.behavior: Routes explosive drones through marked destructible junctions.
entries.counterplay: Shoot a junction to redirect its drone into the command engine.
entries.sound: Hard relay clicks, switching motors, charging drone engines.

entries.name: False Sun
entries.appearance: Radiant stellar organism with layered solar sails
entries.behavior: Harmless outer flares frame dangerous, clearly bounded inner jets.
entries.counterplay: Read the solid jet boundaries and ignore the harmless outer flare.
entries.sound: Immense solar roar, alien choral resonance, contained jet surges.

entries.name: Mirror Court
entries.appearance: Regal assembly of reflective structural shards
entries.behavior: Surrounding mirrors repeat the main attack from new positions.
entries.counterplay: Destroy mirrors to remove the corresponding repeated volleys.
entries.sound: Polished glass shimmer, cascading mirrored echoes, sharp fractures.

entries.name: Signal Thief
entries.appearance: Antenna-covered parasite with exposed receiving organs
entries.behavior: Drains nearby escorts to charge itself while those escorts cease firing.
entries.counterplay: Attack its exposed receivers during the charging window.
entries.sound: Broken radio textures, tuned carrier signals, feedback releases.

entries.name: Lantern Mimic
entries.appearance: Breathing alien capsule with deceptive luminous seams
entries.behavior: Unfolds into an ambush when approached; breathing seams reveal it beforehand.
entries.counterplay: Notice the moving seam and provoke the opening from a safe distance.
entries.sound: Hollow treasure-like chimes, suspicious breathing, muscular jaw snaps.

entries.name: Afterimage Duelist
entries.appearance: Luminous bladed phantom with a dark physical core
entries.behavior: Replays the player’s recent route as a delayed, previewed cutting path.
entries.counterplay: Change direction after the route locks and cross only the cleared trail.
entries.sound: Reversed engine harmonics, blade sweeps, short temporal echoes.

entries.name: Surveyor
entries.appearance: Articulated observatory spacecraft
entries.behavior: Studies the player’s preferred lane before announcing a concentrated attack there.
entries.counterplay: Bait the scan in one lane and punish the exposed telescope from another.
entries.sound: Precision scanner sweeps, measured pulses, observatory motor locks.

entries.name: Cipher Engine
entries.appearance: Glyph-bearing machine with three distinct weapon gates
entries.behavior: Shows a persistent three-symbol sequence before firing those lanes in order.
entries.counterplay: Read the sequence and step into the lane that has already fired.
entries.sound: Three distinct tonal cues, gate actuators, deliberate machine impacts.

entries.name: Rainmaker
entries.appearance: Voluminous storm jellyfish with charged tendrils
entries.behavior: Drops slow charges that descend, pause visibly, and rise on a second pass.
entries.counterplay: Plan for both directions; move through the gaps during the turnaround.
entries.sound: Fine electrical rain, rolling thunder, resonant jellyfish pulses.

entries.name: Comet Shepherd
entries.appearance: Armored shepherd creature guiding stone fragments
entries.behavior: Its guidance organs keep correcting asteroid paths toward the player.
entries.counterplay: Destroy the guidance organs to stop course corrections.
entries.sound: Heavy stone impacts, throaty commands, gravitational rushing.

entries.name: Thunder Loom
entries.appearance: Living conducting lattice with moving charged nodes
entries.behavior: Electricity propagates through moving nodes in an announced order.
entries.counterplay: Break a node to interrupt the traveling discharge.
entries.sound: Traveling electrical arcs, woven metal resonance, thunderous releases.

entries.name: Avalanche Engine
entries.appearance: Massive plated icebreaker and crushing bow
entries.behavior: Pushes a destructible wall of ice through the playfield.
entries.counterplay: Carve a passage before the wall reaches your lane.
entries.sound: Grinding ice, massive compression, crystalline shattering.

entries.name: Ricochet Duchess
entries.appearance: Porcelain crescent with detachable mirror shields
entries.behavior: Bounces clearly warned volleys off destructible reflectors.
entries.counterplay: Remove a reflector to cancel its rebound path.
entries.sound: Ceramic pings, metallic courtly flourishes, crisp ricochet snaps.

entries.name: Lantern Shoal
entries.appearance: Group of individually animated luminous space organisms
entries.behavior: Changes formation to move its open channels; each destroyed organism stays gone.
entries.counterplay: Follow an opening and widen it by defeating the bordering organisms.
entries.sound: Layered aquatic chirps, coordinated calls, soft luminous pops.

entries.name: Nova Anvil
entries.appearance: Massive furnace with suspended hammer and stellar clamps
entries.behavior: Compresses charged mass into a star before a major release.
entries.counterplay: Destroy the clamps to vent the charge safely.
entries.sound: Heavy hydraulics, suspended hammer tension, stellar pressure rumble.

entries.name: Gilded Pilgrim
entries.appearance: Ceremonial armored ship with gold challenge seals
entries.behavior: Optional breakable seals increase both its attack pressure and final reward.
entries.counterplay: Break only as many seals as you can handle; the base kill remains worthwhile.
entries.sound: Ritual bells, deep aerospace engines, heavy gold seal releases.

entries.name: Vault Crawler
entries.appearance: Armored vault crab with separate cargo compartments
entries.behavior: Retreats while protecting several optional high-value compartments.
entries.counterplay: Choose which compartments to open before committing to the central kill.
entries.sound: Heavy scuttling, vault mechanisms, shifting cargo.

entries.name: Oathkeeper
entries.appearance: Luminous-crested structural guardian
entries.behavior: An optional marked challenge gate exposes the core when crossed.
entries.counterplay: Enter the clearly marked gate at a safe moment to create an attack window.
entries.sound: Distinct challenge call, shield resonance, mechanical release.

entries.name: Courier Zero
entries.appearance: Fast cargo courier with a detachable payload
entries.behavior: Separates valuable cargo while the main courier attempts to escape.
entries.counterplay: Choose between the exposed payload and chasing the retreating courier.
entries.sound: Clipped synthetic transmissions, pressured cargo latches, sharp jet snaps.

entries.name: Debt Collector
entries.appearance: Red armored salvage harvester
entries.behavior: Collects only loose score salvage, storing it visibly inside the hull.
entries.counterplay: Defeat the harvester to reclaim its stored score; it cannot steal currency or essential pickups.
entries.sound: Mechanical suction, counting clicks, hard salvage chamber impacts.

entries.name: Mercy Trap
entries.appearance: Wounded mantle creature with protective-looking folds
entries.behavior: Offers a genuine temporary safe pocket, then visibly begins closing it.
entries.counterplay: Use the shelter briefly and leave when the mantle starts to close.
entries.sound: Soothing low hum that becomes structural strain, soft membrane folds.

entries.name: Fortune Leech
entries.appearance: Pale parasitic creature attached to an armored host
entries.behavior: The parasite and host offer a choice of kill order with different risk and reward.
entries.counterplay: Host first is safer; leech first earns more but leaves its protector fighting.
entries.sound: Low feeding pulses, organic suction tears, host armor impacts.

entries.name: Constellation Beast
entries.appearance: Enormous organism built around distinct stellar organs
entries.behavior: Each visible stellar organ sustains a different limb and attack network.
entries.counterplay: Disconnect organs to remove entire parts of its arsenal.
entries.sound: Immense layered stellar harmonics, living structure movement, deep organ collapses.

entries.name: Cathedral of Teeth
entries.appearance: Monumental architectural jaw predator
entries.behavior: Sequences enormous jaws across the upper field while destructible teeth define passages.
entries.counterplay: Break the teeth that would close your escape route.
entries.sound: Monumental creaks, vast breath, thunderous jaw closures.

entries.name: Dying Star
entries.appearance: Fractured stellar organism exposing cooling structures
entries.behavior: Accumulates heat between attacks and progresses toward a controlled collapse.
entries.counterplay: Break the cooling structures in their displayed sequence to vent it safely.
entries.sound: Rising stellar pressure, deep cooling surges, immense final release.

entries.name: Worldmolt
entries.appearance: Planet-armored creature with layers of continental crust
entries.behavior: Sheds crust plates that become moving cover interacting with its attacks.
entries.counterplay: Use the shed crust as cover while attacking newly exposed body seams.
entries.sound: Continental cracks, shifting rock masses, subterranean living rumble.

entries.name: Choir Unbound
entries.appearance: Seven distinct floating armored singers
entries.behavior: Seven voices contribute interlocking attack rhythms; each death removes one contribution.
entries.counterplay: Choose the voice whose pattern blocks your route and silence it first.
entries.sound: Seven original contrasting nonverbal alien vocal motifs, physically weighty movement.

entries.name: Eventide Engine
entries.appearance: Colossal spacecraft under a torn structural sail
entries.behavior: Rotates a heavy weapon array while vulnerable steering thrusters control its turn.
entries.counterplay: Destroy steering thrusters to arrest the rotation and expose the keel.
entries.sound: Vast sail thunder, straining aerospace structure, powerful steering engine pulses.

entries.name: Witness
entries.appearance: Ancient articulated artifact with recording chambers
entries.behavior: Replays three Mystery attacks already encountered this run, one at a time.
entries.counterplay: Recognize the recorded attacks and destroy each artifact chamber to erase its phase.
entries.sound: Recognizable motif echoes reframed by ancient alien recording machinery.
